author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: In the NMC, turn on Syslog Export for the Edge Appliances with the data collector as the server (Filers > Syslog Export Settings), turn on auditing for each volume to watch, and tick Send Audit messages to syslog. Ransomware Protection notifications go out once Syslog Export is on. Audit events (Nasuni's JSON output) go to CloudAudit: the audit type (AUDIT_RENAME, AUDIT_UNLINK and the rest) as event_name, the NMC category (Create, Delete, Rename, Security, Write, Read, Close) as event_type where Nasuni's docs place the type in one, the protocol (CIFS, NFS, FTP, ADMIN) as event_source, the user, SID or uid, client address, path as object_key and the result code as status. Reads and lookups are read_only. The volume, new path, shares, xattr name, mode and directory flag go to request_parameters, and the group, uid, file size and length to additional_event_data. The event time is the record's own UTC timestamp. Three notifications go to the third-party alert schema: a ransomware attack detected (user, client address, volume, signatures and Nasuni's confidence level), the mitigation policy blocking a client address, and antivirus flagging files. Other notifications, such as health monitor and snapshot messages, aren't claimed. The detection wording is the one Edge Appliance 9.14 and later send; older wording may not match. Samples follow the JSON output, field table and audit types on Nasuni's audit events page, with made-up values. Passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-14 (133 of 133 fields matched the emulator in each of 3 runs, and neither parser claimed the other's lines), and no built-in parser claimed these lines in 6 Run Tests.
